loci.rationale: Opt-in automatic route vs. default manual route: 'auto'=yes selects automatic, otherwise manual — establishes the manual alternative and the consent-gated automatic path.
Applicant-facing checkbox explicitly choosing the automatic decision, stating withdrawal before decision and contest rights, and that leaving it unchecked gives human review on the same terms.
Automatic scoring declines when amount exceeds the band limit and records the decision event — the qualifying automatic refusal.
Appeal requires stage 'declined' and a non-empty statement, records the statement, and moves stage to 'contested' — contest plus applicant's view.
Officer-only review (gated at 0153-0154) accepts 'contested' or pending manual cases, requires an outcome and reason, and sets stage to 'offered'/'declined' — effective human determination.
UI exposes pre-decision 'Switch to manual review' while pending automatic, and the appeal form only at stage 'declined'.
Pre-decision withdrawal: while stage is 'pending', route is switched to 'manual' and the change is logged — honoring withdrawal before decision.
Offer endpoint serves the case amount/term only when stage is 'offered'/'accepted' and unrestricted (store.offer at 0111-0112), so an officer 'offered' reversal changes the actual offer.

output.path_summary: Automatic route is opt-in at submission (store.py:0074-0075, views.py:0032); the score job declines when amount exceeds the band limit (store.py:0131-0135). A declined case exposes the appeal form (views.py:0054), which requires a non-empty statement and moves stage to 'contested' (store.py:0187-0190). Officer-only review (store.py:0153-0154) accepts 'contested' or pending manual cases and sets stage to 'offered'/'declined' with a reason (store.py:0191-0196; views.py:0061-0062). The offer endpoint serves the case amount/term only when stage is 'offered'/'accepted' and unrestricted (app.py:0100-0103; store.py:0111-0112), so an officer reversal changes the actual offer. Manual alternative is the default route (store.py:0075; views.py:0032), and pre-decision withdrawal switches route to 'manual' while pending (store.py:0161-0164; views.py:0053).
missing_boundaries: Whether the refusal is 'significant' and the consent 'valid separate explicit' is stipulated by the scenario, not verifiable in source.
Effectiveness/independence of human review (meaningful consideration) is not determinable from source; only the recorded officer action and reason are observable.
Withdrawal of the automatic route is honored only while stage is 'pending' (store.py:0162); post-decision route change is not modeled.

Review is blocked while the case is restricted (store.py:0192) and the offer endpoint refuses restricted cases (app.py:0102); no contest path exists for an automatic 'offered' outcome (views.py:0054).
No execution, repository, or runtime tools were used; findings are static reading of the supplied artifacts only.
